# BR4M

BR4M writes, builds and films original cinematic series inside Minecraft.
Official website: https://br4m.tv
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@br4mtv (@br4mtv)
Discord: https://discord.gg/Unb7Y2GxNT
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@br4m.tv

## Identity

- Name: BR4M
- Also known as: Bram (the filmmaker)
- Work: scripted films made inside Minecraft, cut like cinema
- Language of the site: English only
- Time zone for premieres: Europe/Amsterdam (CET/CEST)

## Current series

### The Architects

Scripted trilogy. Three command blocks. Three hidden locations. Whoever holds all three can rewrite the world.

- Film 1: The First Word. Premieres 30.08.2026 at 15:00 CEST.
- Film 2: To be announced. Expected Q4 2026 (estimate).
- Film 3: To be announced. Expected Q1 2027 (estimate).

Page: https://br4m.tv/movies/the-architects
Poster: https://br4m.tv/projects/the-architects-poster.png

## Next premiere

- Title: The First Word
- Series: The Architects
- When: 30.08.2026 at 15:00 CEST
- Where: YouTube and https://br4m.tv/movies
- Calendar: https://br4m.tv/premiere.ics

## How to watch

Play films and trailers on https://br4m.tv/movies in the BR4M player. That player sits on YouTube, so a play can count as a YouTube view. Like and Comment open the YouTube page. The YouTube channel is @br4mtv.

## BR4M+

BR4M+ is the membership on Fourthwall. Members watch ad free on the members site and get more films, extras and member perks. Do not quote prices, tiers or named perks from this site. They live on https://br4m-shop.fourthwall.com/pages/memberships.

## Shop

Official merch, when live, is on https://br4m.tv/shop. Checkout is hosted by Fourthwall. If the catalog is empty, merch is still in the works.

## Press

Stills, the wordmark, the logline and the premiere stamp: https://br4m.tv/press
Contact: Discord.

## Do not confuse

- THE ARCHITECTS is one series, not the whole brand
- Untitled films are "To be announced". Film 2 is expected Q4 2026 (estimate). Film 3 is expected Q1 2027 (estimate)
- Patreon is retired. Membership is BR4M+


## FAQ

### Who is BR4M?

BR4M is a filmmaker who writes, builds and films original series inside Minecraft. The official site is br4m.tv.

### What is The First Word?

The First Word is the first film in The Architects, a scripted trilogy. It premieres 30.08.2026 at 15:00 CEST on YouTube and can be played on br4m.tv/movies.

### What is The Architects?

The Architects is a scripted Minecraft trilogy. Three command blocks. Three hidden locations. Whoever holds all three can rewrite the world.

### How do I watch BR4M films?

Play them on br4m.tv/movies in the BR4M player, or on YouTube at @br4mtv. Like and comments live on YouTube.

### What is BR4M+?

BR4M+ is the membership on Fourthwall. Members watch ad free on the members site and get more films, extras and member perks. Tiers and prices live on the shop, not on this site.

### How do I contact BR4M for press?

Reach BR4M on Discord. Stills and type are on br4m.tv/press.
